name: Royal Tropical Institute
description: The Royal Tropical Institute (KIT) complex by Johannes van Nieukerken, completed by his sons, was built between 1915 and 1926 in a neo-Renaissance style using one brick colour and one natural stone. It includes the octagonal Marble Hall, a large auditorium and the museum Hall of Light, with a tall bell tower on the corner of Linnaeusstraat and Mauritskade. It housed the Tropenmuseum until the museum became independent in 2014.
funFact: Queen Wilhelmina opened the complex on 9 October 1926; delays came from material shortages in the First World War, strikes and weather.
